tests.name: luajit-std-json-bmp-escape-decode
tests.description: RFC 8259 section 7 BMP escapes: \u00E9 decodes to the raw UTF-8 C3 A9 (U+00E9) scalar and \u4E2D decodes to E4 B8 AD (U+4E2D) — each decoded value is read back through an object-field access on the (string)->table parse result and compared against the raw UTF-8 literal

tests.name: luajit-std-json-surrogate-pair-decode
tests.description: RFC 8259 section 7 surrogate pair: the 12-character form \uD834\uDD1E decodes to the single supplementary scalar U+1D11E (UTF-8 F0 9D 84 9E) — the decoded value read back through an object-field access equals the raw U+1D11E literal; this is the first valid-pair acceptance pin in the conformance tree

tests.name: luajit-std-json-pair-boundaries
tests.description: surrogate-pair boundary code points: \uD800\uDC00 decodes to the lowest supplementary scalar U+10000 (UTF-8 F0 90 80 80) and \uDBFF\uDFFF decodes to the highest U+10FFFF (UTF-8 F4 8F BF BF) — both decoded values read back through object-field accesses equal the raw UTF-8 literals

tests.name: luajit-std-json-escaped-quote-backslash-decode
tests.description: \u0022 and \u005C decode as data, never re-lexed as structure: an object whose field values are the escaped forms parses successfully and the decoded values read back through object-field accesses equal the raw quote and backslash literals

tests.name: luajit-std-json-supplementary-roundtrip
tests.description: supplementary preservation: a raw U+1D11E leaf stringifies with the raw UTF-8 bytes F0 9D 84 9E present and without any \uD834 escape text (plain-text std/string.contains on the stringified text), and the stringify output parses back byte-identically

tests.name: luajit-std-json-scalar-length-crosscheck
tests.description: scalar-value accounting: std/string.length over a decoded mixed BMP/supplementary string (\u00E9 \u4E2D \uD834\uDD1E) counts each of the three scalars once (3, not the 9 UTF-8 bytes)

tests.name: luajit-std-json-lone-high-surrogate-e8001
tests.description: lone high surrogate rejection: the \uD834 escape with no following low-surrogate escape raises E8001 (unpaired surrogate code unit in unicode escape) and exits 1 through the DEAL_ERROR_CODE contract

tests.name: luajit-std-json-lone-low-surrogate-e8001
tests.description: lone low surrogate rejection: the \uDD1E escape without a preceding high-surrogate escape raises E8001 (unpaired surrogate code unit in unicode escape) and exits 1 through the DEAL_ERROR_CODE contract

tests.name: luajit-std-json-pair-mismatch-e8001
tests.description: pair mismatch rejection: the high surrogate \uD834 followed by the non-low-surrogate escape \u0041 raises E8001 (unpaired surrogate code unit in unicode escape) and exits 1 through the DEAL_ERROR_CODE contract

tests.name: luajit-std-json-malformed-u-escape-e8001
tests.description: malformed unicode escape rejection: the truncated \u12 form and the non-hex \uZZZZ form each raise E8001 (invalid unicode escape: expected 4 hex digits) — both earlier calls are wrapped in try/catch with their E8001 codes asserted, and a final uncaught \uZZZZ call exits 1 through the DEAL_ERROR_CODE contract

tests.name: luajit-std-json-unknown-escape-e8001
tests.description: unknown escape rejection: the \x41 and \' forms (outside the RFC 8259 section 7 escape set) each raise E8001 (unknown escape sequence) — both earlier calls are wrapped in try/catch with their E8001 codes asserted, and a final uncaught \x41 call exits 1 through the DEAL_ERROR_CODE contract

tests.name: luajit-std-json-raw-control-e8001
tests.description: raw control rejection: a first parse decodes the escaped control \u0001 into a table field, the byte is read back and spliced into a second parse text (never committed to any source file), and the spliced parse raises E8001 (raw control character in string (must be escaped)) and exits 1 through the DEAL_ERROR_CODE contract
